definition: Captured and awaiting automated validation, duplicate and eligibility checks.
Required data is missing or invalid and awaits correction by the capturing channel.
exit_condition: Data corrected, or lead invalidated or withdrawn

definition: A probable duplicate awaits a human decision.
Valid, unique and eligible; waiting for routing or held in an approved queue.
exit_condition: Active RM assignment created, or lead withdrawn
reporting_treatment: Counted as valid and unassigned (or queued)

definition: Has one active primary RM assignment; contact attempts may be in progress.
exit_condition: Two-way contact, closure, withdrawal or release to queue
reporting_treatment: Counted as assigned; untouched if no activity

definition: Two-way contact with the prospect has occurred.
Prospect is not ready now; follow-up is scheduled with the same owner.
Need, fit and intent confirmed; an opportunity is open.
reporting_treatment: Counted as qualified and as an opportunity created

definition: The opportunity was won and the business became a (synthetic) client.
Closed without conversion (not qualified, no response, lost or not interested).
reporting_treatment: Counted as closed lost by disposition

definition: Fails eligibility or data requirements and will not be worked.
reporting_treatment: Counted as invalid by disposition; excluded from conversion denominators

definition: Confirmed duplicate merged into a surviving lead; its source touch moves to the survivor.
reporting_treatment: Counted as duplicate; excluded from conversion denominators

definition: The prospect withdrew interest or consent before conversion.
